sentences.text:
Main Case No: Crl.P.No.2441 of 2026
 Proceeding Sheet
Sl. Date Order Office
No.
NOTE 01. 31.03.2026 Dr.YLR, J  Issue notice to the respondent No.2.
The learned counsel for the petitioners is permitted to take out personal notice to the respondent No.2 and file proof to that effect.

Heard Sri P. Girish Kumar, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners and the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor.
The respondent No.2 alleges that the accused have committed offences of cheating as well as criminal breach of trust.
However, the offences of cheating and criminal breach of trust do not ordinarily go together, as they are conceptually distinct and operate in different spheres.

The Hon'ble Apex Court, in Delhi Race Club (1940) Ltd v. State of Uttar Pradesh1 N. Raghavender v.
State of Andhra Pradesh2, has recognized the distinction between these offences.

Crl.A.No.3114 of 2024 dated 23.08.2025 Crl.A.No.5 of 2010 dated 13.12.2021 Dr.YLR, J Dated 31.03.2026 SL.
DATE ORDER OFFICE NO. NOTE 31.03.2026
The respondent No.2 addressed a letter/complaint to the Chairman, A.P. State Commission for Scheduled Castes.

The said complaint was subsequently registered as a case in Crime No.90 of 2026 for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 420, 406, and 506 read with Section 34 of the I.P.C., and Section 3(1)(r) of the SC/ST (PoA) Act.

The record reveals that, initially, the Chairman of the Scheduled Castes Commission directed the Superintendent of Police, Tirupati, to conduct an inquiry into the complaint lodged by respondent No.2.
The Superintendent of Police, Tirupati, in turn, directed the Inspector of Police, Alipiri Police Station, to conduct an inquiry and submit a report.

Accordingly,
the Inspector submitted a report, which was forwarded to the Commission.

However, without recording any findings on the said report, the Chairman of the Commission again directed the Superintendent of Police, Tirupati, to conduct a fresh inquiry through an officer not below the rank of Sub- Divisional Police Officer.
Pursuant thereto, the Sub-Divisional Police Officer conducted an inquiry.
contd...
Dr.YLR, J  Dated 31.03.2026 SL.

1 NO. NOTE  31.03.2026
However, based on the said inquiry, an FIR came to be registered.

In fact, none of the provisions of the A.P. State Commission for Scheduled Castes Act, 2019 empowers the Chairman of the A.P. Scheduled Castes Commission to direct the police to register an FIR or to conduct any investigation.

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: In this regard, the High Court of Delhi, in Anju Bala v. Municipal Corporation of Delhi3, has observed that the Commission has no authority to direct the police to register a case or conduct an inquiry.
